title: Playground and Websim fit better inside /play
summary:
Playground and Websim got tidier embeds, themes began following users across apps, and Kimi and MiniMax gained room for more images.

Embedded Playground and Websim keep their auth menus, omit titles already shown by the host tab, and report their content height so /play can size the frames without an internal scrollbar. Websim’s shell also now matches Playground’s width; a follow-up fixed the height-reporting build.

Enter, Playground, Websim, React, and Model Monitor now share a theme preference across pollinations.ai subdomains. Embedded apps can receive theme changes without reloading, and the auth modal backdrop now matches its surrounding page.

`kimi-k2.7-code` and `minimax-m3` now accept up to 30 reference images instead of 10. Both moved to Fireworks while keeping their public names; MiniMax M3’s registered context length is now 524,288 tokens. Qwen Large also moved to Fireworks’ `qwen3p7-plus` route.

daily.title: Thirty image references
daily.text: Send up to 30 reference images to `kimi-k2.7-code` or `minimax-m3`, up from 10. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Qwen Large route updated
daily.text: Qwen Large now uses `qwen3p7-plus` behind its existing public model name. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Better embedded apps
daily.text: Playground and Websim keep their auth menus inside `/play` and fit their frames to their content, without the extra internal scrollbar. [Try the Playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Theme follows you
daily.text: Your light or dark theme choice carries across pollinations.ai apps, including embedded views. An already-open embed can change theme without reloading. [Try the Playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).
